title: suberanthus neriifolius
intro: Suberanthus neriifolius, commonly known as the Neriifolia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Suberanthus neriifolius include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
